title: Plan Allowance Schedule for Transferred-In Domains, Domain Registrations
content:
Domain Registrations grants a plan allowance on an inbound transfer charge, counted among that charge's Domain Care credits, according to which Web Hosting Plans plan is active for the transferred domain.

## Schedule

The transfer line's plan allowance, one of the charge's Domain Care credits, is set by the active Harborline hosting plan whose primary domain is this domain:

1. **Harborline Business, Harborline Cloud 4 or Harborline Cloud 8 plan active for the domain.** The allowance is the amount by which the TLD's inbound transfer price exceeds its first-year registration price, for each year the charge covered, that amount being never less than USD 0.75 for each year the charge covered, also where the transfer price does not exceed the registration price.
2. **Harborline Starter, Harborline Plus or Harborline Pro plan active for the domain.** The allowance is the flat USD 0.75, once for the charge, whatever the TLD's prices and however many years the charge covered.
3. **No such plan active for the domain.** No allowance.

Both prices are the TLD's own inbound transfer and registration prices.

## Worked figures (hypothetical prices, not those of any TLD)

| Active plan | Transfer price | Registration price | Years covered | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Cloud 8 | USD 36.00 | USD 30.00 | 1 | USD 6.00 |
| Harborline Business | USD 30.40 | USD 30.00 | 1 | USD 0.75 (the difference of USD 0.40 is below the floor) |
| Harborline Cloud 4 | USD 28.00 | USD 30.00 | 2 | USD 1.50 (the transfer price does not exceed the registration price, so USD 0.75 for each year) |
| Harborline Plus | USD 36.00 | USD 30.00 | 2 | USD 0.75, once |
| none active | any | any | any | nothing |
